about: GTA 6 'It has X, shown' + real Florida (Delta, slug gta-iguana): Rockstar's own Only in Leonida page captions a screenshot 'An iguana walks in front of a mobility scooter in the Leonida Keys', the iguana is on the street in front of a blue mobility scooter (the trailer iguana is not used: that shot is in gta-everytrailer). Real world, labeled REAL FLORIDA: FWC says green iguanas are not native to Florida and are invasive; NWS Miami tweeted on Jan 21 2020 'don't be surprised if you see Iguanas falling from the trees tonight'; FWC says 5,195 cold-stunned green iguanas were brought in under EO 26-03 on Feb 1-2, 2026. Never claims iguanas fall, freeze or get hit in the game. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six has iguanas.

lines.text: Rockstar's own caption calls it an iguana, in the Leonida Keys.
lines.say: Rockstar's own caption calls it an iguana, in the Lee-oh-nee-dah Keys.

lines.text: Right in the street, in front of a mobility scooter.
Except in real Florida, green iguanas are invasive.
Miami's weather service once forecast falling iguanas.
Last winter, a cold snap stunned them.
People turned in over 5,000 in two days.
lines.say: People turned in over five thousand in two days.

lines.text: Would you brake for one? Yes or no.
